problem_title: Get lists of dependent picklist options in Apex
caption:
Get lists of dependent picklist options in Apex

🔴 The Problem: I have a pair of dependent picklists. In Apex code, how can I determine what options are valid in the dependent field for each option in the controlling field? I've tried using getPicklistValues() , but there doesn't seem to be any way of getting dependency information. Example Controlling_Field__c Fruit, Vegetable, Dairy Dependent_Field__c (Fruit): Apple, Banana, Pear (Vegetable): Tomato, Egglant, Lettuce (Dairy):...

✅ The Fix: Salesforce doesn't reveal information about dependent picklists in normal Describe calls in Apex, but it is included in calls via the API, and can also be accessed through Apex by serializing and deserializing PicklistEntry objects (see gist linked below for an example of how to do that).
